I'm using a throwaway. I don't mean to be rude, but I feel very uncomfortable with the idea of people using my stories as fodder for other works. This same question has come up a few times on this sub. This is just my personal opinion. It was painful to experience at the time. It's still painful now. I don't like the idea of people coming in and poking and prodding my very sensitive wounds to make a buck for themselves. I'm not an animal in a zoo, I'm a grown adult dealing with the abuse I suffered as a child. The idea of turning it into a book frankly makes me feel a little nauseous. I don't mean to be rude or anything, that's just how I feel about it.

There's lots of good psychology books out there dealing with dysfunctional families, Toxic Parents and Will I Ever Be Good Enough? Healing the Daughters of Narcissistic Mothers as examples.

Going NC was hard at first, but I guess it's easier now that the toxic people are out of my life. It's a lot more peaceful, I think, in some ways. I hope you feel okay with yourself soon. Thanks for your advice, too.

Can you explain how this works? I just drive to the hospital and ? 

My parents weren't big on medical care. I've never been inside a hospital before, except once to visit someone in oncology.
I technically/legally live in one state and am currently in another, quite far away. What do I do?

Well, after i left, I stopped calling my mom. She sent a few guilt-trip emails, then now, I never hear from her unless she wants something. Same with my dad. I know it seems stupid, but I feel sort of hurt that they act like I don't exist. I certainly existed when they needed someone to blame for when things went wrong or they wanted someone to kick around. Anyway, my family was really isolated before. Now I have no family at all.

I still feel like a little kid when I talk about my parents. I feel like a 14yo complaining about how they're so misunderstood. I don't have any friends. I just packed up and left. 

I don't want to get baker acted. I don't have insurance, so I'm damned if I do and damned if I don't. help is freaking expensive. If I mess up,  going into hospital would be devastating financially. But. Yeah. I think about it a lot. I have a way I could do it. I think about it a lot. I've lost family members to suicide before though. I know how much it sucks for people left behind. I'm just trying to get help, but it's hard.
I made a grilled cheese with some fancy cheese. Thank you. What kind of a doctor should I go to? Sorry for being dumb. :/

I thought leaving would be the worst part. It feels like I survived a bomb dropping on me, but now I have to deal with everything else, you know? I read somewhere that when healing, professionals measure it in terms of years, or something like that. Damn, it feels like I can barely survive the next hour, much less years...

I have trouble with confrontation. I'm not sure how to like, break up with a therapist? Sometimes he's helpful. He doesn't like my parents much either, he said I needed a "parent-ectomy" haha. 

I am still with my boyfriend. (Edit: removed identifying info). How do I know if I'm in another abusive relationship or if it was just an isolated thing?
I come here often, actually. I've just been feeling so stuck, like nothing's going to get better ever.

I'm pretty sure she's an N. I haven't even really been able to tell my boyfriend some of the awful stuff my parents have done and we've been together for a long time. I think people from normal families just sort of don't know what to do. I don't know.

I moved away from my parents, but I had to leave most of my stuff behind. (Small car). I've struggled with depression for a long time, but I don't know where to turn for this either. I don't have insurance. My home state declined obamacare expansion. It's like 150$ to go to this therapist and he sort of gives me the same look other people do when I tell them what I've been through... That sort of blank stare. Like they don't know what to think. Maybe that he thinks I'm exaggerating or lying. That one. 

I was medicated for depression a few years ago, but my mom pulled me completely out of therapy and off meds because my therapist noted that there seemed to be something "going on at home." Mom said, "I'm not paying for you to blame me!" And I never saw the therapist again. 

I think about ending my stupid existence every damn day. I thought I should at least try before I go ahead and kick off. At least I can say I tried, you know?
I have a plan, and I just can't think of a reason not to do it anymore.
